title: ADR frontmatter (decisions/ADR-<NNN>-<slug>.md)
description: The YAML frontmatter every Architecture Decision Record in decisions/ starts with. Project-wide decisions (stack, cross-cutting architecture, permission model) are written down once here so an agent reads one instead of re-litigating it on the next run. Validated by orchestrator/src/decisions/decisionLog.ts.

id.description: Stable identifier. Equal to the leading ADR-<NNN> of the filename — one identifier, not a mapping to keep in sync.

title.description: One-sentence summary of the decision, not the topic — "Use PostgreSQL with Prisma", not "Database".

status.description: proposed = written down, not yet binding, an agent may still ask about it. accepted = settled, implement without asking. superseded = replaced by a later ADR (must carry superseded_by). rejected = considered and turned down, kept so the option isn't re-proposed.

date.description: The date the status above became true, asked from the user per policies/documentation.md's §3 dating rule — never inferred by an agent.

supersedes.description: The ADR id this record replaces, if any.

superseded_by.description: The ADR id that replaces this record. Required once status is "superseded".
